history.summary: A Hindu temple dedicated to Goddess Durga, located at Gali Affim Wali near Post Office Bazar, Bathinda. NOTE: despite the name 'Prachin' (ancient), the temple's own website states it was constructed by Dr Sohanlal Gupta (son of Lala Ramjidas Gupta and Kripadevi Gupta) and his wife Raj Rani Gupta, with the idol's consecration (pran pratishtha) performed on 10 April 2022 (Chaitra Shukla Navami / Ram Navami). Whether the name refers to an older shrine or an older idol relocated here is not stated on the site — the antiquity of the name is UNVERIFIED. Contact: +91 9920522522, prachindurgamatamandir@gmail.com; temple runs donation programmes and publishes a donor list. NO RELIABLE IMAGE FOUND — the temple's official website lists its own photos but its image server times out on fetch; third-party images (e.g. Pinterest) are generic Durga-idol photos of unverified provenance, so media is intentionally left empty.

name: Prachin Durga Mata Mandir
town_description: Bathinda is one of the oldest cities in Punjab, known for the historic Qila Mubarak fort. It is an administrative and railway junction city in the Malwa region, with a mix of Sikh, Hindu and Muslim heritage sites. The city hosts two historic Sikh gurdwaras — Qila Mubarak Sahib and Haji Rattan Sahib — alongside old Hindu temples.

travel.airport: Bathinda Airport (~20-25 km northwest) (verify); Chandigarh International Airport ~230 km.
travel.railway: Bathinda Junction (~2-3 km) is a major rail junction on the Delhi–Ferozepur line.
travel.road: Centrally located near Post Office Bazar, Bathinda 151001; easily reached by local auto, taxi or bus.

visitor_information.best_time: October to March; Navratri (March-April and Sep-Oct) is the main festival season.
visitor_information.opening_hours: 4:00 AM – 9:00 PM per the temple's place listing (verify — conflicting timings appear on directory sites).
